features.title: Phase 1 - Cloud Video Streaming & Edge Ingestion
highlights: Ultra-low-latency WebRTC WHEP streaming (<500ms) over HTTPS
Dynamic MediaMTX multi-tenant authentication webhook (strict user isolation)
Zero-port-forwarding outbound RTSP TCP edge push
Automatic ONVIF / WS-Discovery LAN camera scanning
Real-time round-trip latency (RTT) & live status monitoring
Native ARM64 container optimization on Oracle Cloud Ampere A1 (K3s)
